chapters.reason: The paper introduces linear attention by expressing self-attention as a linear dot-product of kernel feature maps, utilizing the associativity property to maintain a matrix-valued hidden state that evolves linearly.
The approach effectively converts the standard Transformer architecture into a recurrent model, allowing for constant-memory inference and linear complexity.
The method shares the goal of Infini-attention in enabling streaming of long sequences with constant memory through linear-based state updates.
